insights.prediction: Tomato is currently the most profitable crop, commanding the highest price of INR 3,400 per quintal in 2026 after a sustained and sharp upward trajectory. This price shift is driven by escalating consumer demand and supply chain constraints, while staple crops like Wheat and Paddy continue to offer steady, low-risk margin growth.
insights.alert: Onions exhibit high price volatility with sharp dips, notably in 2023 and 2025. Highly perishable crops like Tomatoes and Onions must be prioritized for immediate market clearance or stored in climate-controlled facilities to prevent post-harvest spoilage and to avoid sudden market downturns.

insights.prediction: Wheat is currently demonstrating strong profitability, maintaining higher prices around ₹2,500-2,510/quintal towards the end of the year due to tightening market arrivals and sustained off-season demand post-harvest.
insights.alert: Tomato prices are dropping rapidly from their September peak of ₹3,600/quintal down to ₹2,900 in December. Due to their highly perishable nature, farmers should clear tomato stock immediately to prevent spoilage and mitigate loss from continuing price corrections.
